name: Pearls
overview: Scripture uses pearls as a powerful metaphor to illustrate the incomparable value of wisdom and the kingdom of heaven, as seen in the parable of the merchant who sold all to obtain a pearl of great price (Matthew 13:45-46). Pearls symbolize precious truths that must be guarded carefully, warning believers not to cast these holy and valuable teachings before those who will not appreciate them, likened to swine who trample and turn against the giver (Matthew 7:6). This imagery underscores the surpassing worth of divine wisdom, which is esteemed even above rubies (Job 28:18), and calls believers to discernment in sharing the gospel and spiritual treasures.
